description: This Java class `EntityModelReader` models the `<entity-model-reader>` element in an XML configuration for the OFBiz framework. It reads the element's attributes and nested `<resource>` elements to initialize its state, providing access to the `name` attribute and the list of associated resources.

classes.name: EntityModelReader
classes.description: A class that models the `<entity-model-reader>` element in the configuration XML, capable of initializing from an XML Element and providing access to its name and resource list.

methods.name: EntityModelReader
methods.description: Constructor that reads and processes an XML element to initialize the EntityModelReader object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the `name` attribute of the `<entity-model-reader>` element.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of `<resource>` child elements associated with this entity model reader.
